name: continente
description: Continente (continente.pt) session panel: store or clear the browser cookie jar (vault-backed), probe login state, search, and add to the account cart.

views.title: Session
views.description: Store the session from a logged-in browser: open continente.pt, open devtools console, run copy(document.cookie), paste the result below. The jar is stored encrypted in the vault and never shown back. To clear the stored session: DELETE /api/continente/session (or ask the agent 'clear my continente session').
